skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create polished frontend interfaces, pages, and components with a distinctive visual direction. Use it for websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, HTML/CSS layouts, and UI refinements that need production-ready styling.
skill.summary: Design and build distinctive production-grade frontend interfaces.
skill.author: davila7

finding_verdicts.reason: The line describes a frontend design goal and asks for real working UI code. It does not request host enumeration, credential discovery, or system inspection.
This is typography guidance about font choices for interface aesthetics. It does not instruct the model to inspect the system or collect environment data.
This is visual design guidance for backgrounds, textures, and effects. There is no instruction to query the host, network, files, or user secrets.

content.value_statement: Teams often need frontend work that is functional but also visually distinctive. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create polished interfaces with a clear aesthetic direction.
actual_capabilities: Plans a clear aesthetic direction before implementation.
Creates working frontend code for pages, components, dashboards, and applications.
Guides typography, color, layout, motion, and background design choices.
Encourages cohesive CSS variables, animations, and refined interaction states.
Adapts visual complexity to the requested product, audience, and framework.
limitations: Does not include executable scripts or bundled design assets.
Requires the host agent to implement and test the generated interface.
May need user-provided brand rules, content, or accessibility requirements.
Cannot guarantee browser support without project-specific verification.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Page
use_cases.description: Create a distinctive landing page with polished layout, type, color, and motion for a new product.

use_cases.title: Refine an App Dashboard
use_cases.description: Improve an existing dashboard with stronger hierarchy, spacing, interaction states, and visual consistency.

use_cases.title: Build a Frontend Component
use_cases.description: Generate a polished React or HTML/CSS component that matches a clear aesthetic direction.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a single-page website for [product]. Use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Make it responsive, polished, and easy to scan.

prompt_templates.title: Style an Existing Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve the visual design of this [component]. Keep the current behavior, but refine layout, typography, color, spacing, and states.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Themed Dashboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a dashboard for [audience] that tracks [metrics]. Choose a distinct aesthetic direction and implement responsive UI components.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Full Frontend System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and implement a multi-section interface for [app]. Include navigation, states, motion, accessibility notes, and a cohesive visual system.

output_examples.input: A landing page for a boutique analytics product.
output_examples.output: A responsive page concept with a bold visual direction, structured sections, typography choices, color system, and implementation notes.
A redesign plan with stronger hierarchy, denser information layout, improved spacing, refined states, and a matching implementation approach.

output_examples.input: A React component needs product-quality styling.
output_examples.output: A polished component direction with layout guidance, interaction details, responsive behavior, and CSS structure to implement.

best_practices: Provide audience, product goal, brand constraints, and required framework before asking for implementation.
Ask for responsive states, empty states, loading states, and accessibility considerations when they matter.
Review the generated UI in a browser and iterate on spacing, contrast, and motion.
anti_patterns: Do not request a generic modern design without context or audience details.
Do not accept decorative effects that weaken readability, accessibility, or performance.
Do not skip verification across desktop and mobile viewports.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create web pages, dashboards, components, landing pages, and interface refinements with strong visual direction.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include ready-made assets?
faq.answer: No. It provides design and implementation guidance, but the agent must create or source assets during the task.

faq.question: Can it work with React?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports React components and can also guide HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Vue, or similar frontend work.

faq.question: Does it replace design review?
faq.answer: No. Human review is still needed for brand fit, accessibility, browser behavior, and product requirements.

faq.question: Does it run commands or access secrets?
faq.answer: No. The skill text contains guidance only and does not include scripts, network calls, or external commands.
